Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation

Hybrid (minimum of 2-3 days a week from the office)

**

Shape the Future of Privacy**

Usercentrics is a global leader in data privacy and privacy-led marketing solutions. We believe there is no need for a trade-off between growth and privacy compliance. Our vision is to unlock the potential of data privacy to empower a thriving digital ecosystem. We work with companies to create a healthy balance between data-driven business and privacy-led marketing for every size of enterprise. Our customers build trust with their users through improved transparency and control to drastically improve marketing and monetization, while achieving full privacy compliance.

**About the Role

**Revenue Operations is the horizontal backbone behind Usercentrics' three go-to-market motions — Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led. As we scale, our Salesforce ecosystem and wider GTM tech stack need a single owner who can turn ambitious business requirements into governed, scalable systems. As Manager, GTM Systems & Innovation, you'll lead a team spanning Salesforce administration and GTM engineering, and you'll be the one deciding how AI-native automation gets built into our GTM workflows. You'll partner closely with other Revenue Operations teams, the broader GTM organization, and stakeholders across Finance and Product to translate business requirements into efficient, reliable systems.

**Responsibilities

**> Own CRM architecture and governance end-to-end, ensuring Salesforce supports Self Serve, Sales Led, and Partner Led without compromising on data integrity.

> Set the roadmap and standards for the wider GTM tech stack, tying every major investment to a clear business outcome - pipeline quality, forecasting reliability, or support efficiency - not just tool delivery.

> Lead and grow a small team spanning Salesforce administration, Salesforce architecture, and GTM engineering, keeping the team focused on high-impact initiatives tied to clear business outcomes, and acting as the final technical decision-maker on system changes.

> Drive AI-native workflows and automation across GTM - from propensity and churn scoring models to workflow automation - that reduce manual work, increase seller and CS productivity, and improve the customer experience.

> Own attribution and data hygiene practices, partnering closely with BI on the underlying data infrastructure and pipeline.

> Drive adoption and value realization of the systems you build, partnering with GTM Enablement to make sure new capabilities actually change day-to-day behavior, not just go live.

> Continuously evaluate GTM tooling and market trends, bringing investment recommendations to the VP of Revenue Operations based on expected business impact and ROI.

Requirements

Experience

> 5+ years of experience in RevOps, Salesforce administration and GTM systems, with real ownership of architecture-level decisions.

> Experience managing a technical team in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

Technical Skills

> Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise (architecture, automation, integrations).

> Practical experience with tools like n8n, Clay, and Outreach, and with AI-assisted workflows in a revenue context.

Operating Skills

> Strong data instincts: comfortable owning attribution, data hygiene, and governance across a growing tech stack.

> Confident operating independently and making system decisions without needing to escalate every call.

> Comfortable being the technical backstop for a Solution Architect, Administrator, and Engineer, without needing to do the hands-on build yourself day to day.

Benefits

Include:

> Development Budget for every employee: 800,- EUR / year

> Job-related Language Courses (English, German, Czech, Spanish etc.): 350,- EUR / year

> Hybrid working policy and the possibility to take a workcation (90 days per year from a European country

> Online yoga sessions

> Massages

> Headspace App

> Events - Team Buildings, happy hours, parties/get togethers, occasional company covered breakfasts/lunches, in/across offices, online/in person etc

> Gifts - We celebrate life & work milestones at UC (work anniversaries, new born babies and similar)

> Snacks, fruits, coffee and drinks in the office

Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast-growing, diverse and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially-minded who build our success story together

Company culture is important to us - we strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally

Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love to see people from all department enthusiastically participating and shaping our future together in different cross-department projects

Your work-life balance is important to us too - we offer flexible working hours, hybrid working and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy)

We always remember to have fun along the way, both in our day-to-day work and at our regular team events on site in our offices in Munich, Copenhagen, Odense, Lisbon, New York and Buenos Aires or online

You are the most valuable asset to our company which is why we’re happy to offer awesome benefits like our personal development budget, job-related language courses and a lot more (depending on your location) to focus on your well being

Usercentrics is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Do you want to shape the engineering direction behind technology that drives the energy sector?

At Mind Energy, technology enables how we trade, optimise and evolve in a fast-moving energy market. As our Senior Software Engineer, you take a central role in building and evolving the digital backbone that supports critical business decisions every day.

You combine strong technical depth with architectural thinking and a hands-on engineering mindset. Working closely with experienced colleagues across development and business, you help shape scalable systems, influence technical direction and raise the engineering bar around you.

DIVE INTO WHAT YOUR DAY-TO-DAY TASKS WILL BE

In this role, you take an active par t in shaping the technical direction of our digital landscape. You modernise existing systems, build new solutions and turn complexity into reliable, scalable software that supports both trading and long-term growth.

Your mission is to:

• Design, develop, test and deploy stable, scalable and secure software solutions

• Take architectural responsibility and influence the long-term direction of our digital platform

• Build resilient services and systems designed for performance, scalability and maintainability

• Drive technical improvements and challenge existing solutions with a strong engineering mindset

• Collaborate closely across teams while supporting knowledge sharing, sparring and engineering quality

JOIN A TEAM OF MINDFUL ACHIEVERS

You’ll join an autonomous, cross-functional team with end-to-end ownership of its domain, spanning design, architecture, implementation and operations.

Together, you work closely with business stakeholders to translate complex needs into robust, scalable and secure solutions that create real value for our customers.

At Mind Energy, we value both independence and collaboration.

Your work ranges from refining existing systems to shaping entirely new solutions, always with a clear sense of ownership and responsibility. You approach complexity with curiosity and turn challenges into solutions built to last.

LET’S SWITCH THE FOCUS TO YOU

You are an experienced engineer who thrives with ownership, technical responsibility and the opportunity to influence how solutions are designed and built. You bring strong engineering fundamentals, architectural understanding and the confidence to challenge decisions when better

solutions exist.

We imagine that you bring:

• Extensive experience building scalable systems in C# and .NET, with a consistent approach to clean, maintainable code and modern design patterns

• Hands-on experience designing and building resilient, event-driven services in distributed and cloud-native environments

• Experience balancing scalability, reliability and maintainability when designing architectures for complex production systems

• Experience taking technical ownership and helping shape engineering direction through architectural decisions, sparring and pragmatic technical leadership

If you also have insight into the energy sector, it will be an advantage, but it is not required.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply, as we believe that a diverse team leads to innovation and success.

Please note that this role requires working from our office location Aarhus N.

WE MIGHT BE BIASED, BUT IT IS QUITE AWESOME HERE

People here care about doing things well and creating a place people genuinely enjoy being part of. We like to hack the everyday, from breakfast and lunch made in-house with organic ingredients to in-house massage, something in the freezer when the day runs late and the occasional “Just Because” surprise. You also get five Switch Days, equal to a seventh holiday week, giving you extra flexibility and room to recharge throughout the year.

Through Mind Club, people come together around everything from padel and Football Shirt Fridays to clay pigeon shooting and Christmas afternoons with your family and Santa. And with Mind Academy, you grow alongside sharp and curious colleagues who challenge ideas, share knowledge and help each other level up. These are just some of the things that make us special. It’s easier to experience in person.

We’re mindful achievers. It shapes how we work, think and grow together, while recognising that well-being, care and integrity matter just as much as the results we create. This is a place to focus, grow and achieve more.

LET US GET THIS CONVERSATION STARTED

If this sounds like the right fit for you - do not wait - send your resume as soon as you can, and no later than November 6, 2026.

We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Got questions or need more details? Reach out to Tony Frydensberg, Director, Head of IT Development at: tofr@mindenergy.com.

For general questions reach out to people@mindenergy.com

What if your code shaped the future of energy?

Energy is changing. Fast. And at Mind Energy, we’re right at the epicentre of it all.

For decades, we have led the way in European energy trading - impatiently pushing forward, turning our deep market knowledge into reliable solutions and trading strategies. Today, we trade across more than 40 markets. But it’s how we work that defines us: with curiosity, care and a mindset of “what if”. We listen, share, and push ideas forward - together.

Here, people matter, and we grow as specialists and as teammates. We bring many kinds of intelligence into play – from sharp thinking to smart models. That’s what makes us energy minds.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**Why this role is important to us

**Group IT keeps SimCorp running. The same discipline we bring to our clients' investment operations is applied to our own enterprise platforms. Workday and Salesforce are at the center of how we manage our people and client relationships.

As Senior Director, Enterprise Applications, you will own the strategy, governance, and operational health of Workday and Salesforce across the organization. You will serve as the primary accountable leader for these platforms, partnering closely with business functions to ensure secure, compliant, and reliable operations through your leadership team and subject matter experts.

This is a senior leadership position with high visibility across Group IT, P&C, and Sales, providing direct influence over the evolution of two of SimCorp's most business-critical enterprise platforms.

You will step directly into a strategic and business-critical transformation initiative: the migration of financial processes and data from Workday to SAP S/4HANA, with a planned go-live in January 2027. Success in this role requires the ability to quickly engage in data mapping, integration planning, stakeholder alignment, and cross-functional execution from day one.

**The organization consists of:

**

• 5 individual contributors reporting directly to the role

• 2 managers reporting directly to the role

• 29 employees in total across the Enterprise Applications area

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Define and own the multi-year strategy, roadmap, and operating model for Workday and Salesforce, aligning platform capabilities and investments with business priorities and growth objectives

• Establish and chair platform governance forums with P&C, Sales, Customer Success, and other key stakeholders to prioritize enhancements, integrations, releases, and investment decisions

• Ensure the stability, performance, security, and availability of Workday and Salesforce through effective release management, testing, monitoring, and change control practices

• Oversee the end-to-end integration landscape across Workday, Salesforce, SAP S/4HANA

• Manage strategic relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers, including contracts, licensing, and commercial oversight in partnership with Software Asset Management

• Own platform security and access governance, including role design, segregation of duties, periodic access reviews, and compliance with internal control requirements

• Partner closely with Information Security, Risk, Compliance, and Internal Audit teams to ensure effective controls, timely remediation activities, and adherence to GDPR and other regulatory requirements

• Drive continuous improvement and adoption of platform capabilities to increase business value, operational efficiency, and user experience across the organization

**What We Value

**

• 10+ years of leadership experience in enterprise applications, with deep expertise in Workday and Salesforce, or solid hands-on experience in one platform combined with demonstrated leadership responsibility for the other

• 5+ years of people management experience leading teams of platform owners, administrators, business analysts, or related application specialists

• A proven track record of establishing and operating governance models for enterprise platforms in a global, regulated, or financial services environment

• Solid understanding of enterprise integration architectures.

• Experience managing SaaS vendors, software licensing, commercial agreements, and strategic partner relationships

• Solid knowledge of data privacy, risk, and security frameworks, including GDPR, SOC 2, and ISO 27001

• Effective stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively at both executive and technical levels

• Workday and/or Salesforce certifications are considered an advantage

**Benefits

**Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp, we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work and work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. And opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we provide custom paths for professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**For Poland Location

**Compensation ranges are being disclosed at the initial stage of candidate engagement.

Visit our career pages to learn more about working at SimCorp: www.simcorp.com/career

**Next steps

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

**Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

**At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

Join IO Interactive’s Finance team at our Copenhagen Studio as Finance Director and play a key role in shaping the financial direction of a multi-studio, multi-entity games company. You will lead the Finance function, drive the automation of the finance processes, and act as the CFO's trusted partner and second-in-command. Responsible for the day-to-day leadership of Finance while providing strategic, financial, and commercial guidance that supports IO Interactive's continued growth across all studios.

If you are a strategic finance leader who combines commercial understanding with strong technical expertise, we would love to meet you.

**Please note that our finance team is primarily based in Copenhagen, and we would love local leadership; this position requires you to be on-site at our Copenhagen studio.

****What You Will Do

****Finance Leadership

**

• Lead the day-to-day Finance organisation across IO Interactive's global studios.

• Manage, drive, mentor, and develop Finance team members while building a high-performing and collaborative function.

• Drive the ongoing project of full automation of the finance process

• Act as the CFO's right-hand and trusted sparring partner on both operational and strategic matters.

• Ensure strong financial governance, controls, compliance, and scalable finance processes across the organisation.

**Financial & Business Leadership

**

• Own budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning across all studios and entities.

• Provide strategic financial insight and recommendations to the CFO and senior leadership team.

• Translate financial and operational performance into clear actions and business recommendations.

• Support decision-making related to investments, headcount planning, studio growth and organisational development.

• Partner with Production, Commercial, Technology and Corporate leadership on financial performance and business priorities.

• Drive performance management through meaningful reporting, KPIs and financial analysis.

**Controlling & Governance

**

• Upscale and improve Financial and Business controlling.

• Oversee Accounting, Financial Controlling and Business Controlling activities across the organisation.

• Ensure accurate management reporting and financial visibility across studios, projects and functions.

• Oversee external audits, statutory compliance, and financial risk management.

• Support finance transformation, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Who You Are

**

• Significant experience in a senior Finance leadership role.

• Strong background across Accounting, Financial Controlling and Business Controlling.

• Experience leading and driving Finance teams in a complex international organisation.

• Strong commercial mindset with the ability to influence strategic business decisions.

• Experience partnering with executive stakeholders and senior leadership teams.

• Excellent understanding of financial reporting, governance, planning, and performance management.

• Strong leadership skills and ability to operate as a trusted advisor.

**We would love it if you had

**

• Experience working in the gaming industry.

• Previous experience in an audit firm earlier in your career.

• Experience supporting multi-studio, multi-entity, or international organisations.

• Experience with ERP transformations

• Experience with Unit4 or similar ERP systems.

• Experience with Prophix or similar systems.

• Accounting qualification such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CMA or equivalent.

**Who We Are

**IO Interactive is an independent video game development and publishing company with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, and Brighton. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last decade, we are committed to creating unforgettable characters and experiences—powered by our award-winning, proprietary Glacier technology.

IOI is a studio that values in-person collaboration. Being together helps us focus our collective energy on our immediate goals. For us, being both in-office as well as connected across our studios helps us integrate our teams faster, strengthen relationships, and improve knowledge-sharing. We believe that the more time we spend together, the more quality and progress we achieve for our games and players.

We know that to achieve those goals, we need courage, talented people, and a great working environment—and we do our utmost to have all of that. Across our multiple studios, we’re working on several projects. Crucially, though, we’re all one team. We value the work and impact that each person brings to the table, and we actively encourage new ideas whilst listening to your insights along the way.

With more than 50 nationalities, we know that everyone is different, and we are proud to have a reputation for being a friendly workplace with highly talented people.

IO Interactive is an independent video game development and publishing company with studios in Copenhagen, Malmö, Barcelona, Brighton and Istanbul. As the creative force behind some of the most talked-about multiplatform video games in the last decade, we are dedicated to creating unforgettable characters and experiences – all powered by our award-winning proprietary Glacier technology.

**The Role

**The Senior Manager, Clinical Programming is responsible for the establishment, governance, and integrity of Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) standards, perform sponsor oversight of relevant programming activities on the Biometrics vendor, ensure the quality and consistency of data standards to support the portfolio towards the ultimate objective of data quality and consistency across programs and systems.

**Responsibilities

**

• Develops and implements company Study Data Tabulation Model (SDTM) standards that support the scientific need of a study/program while ensuring quality, consistency and compliance to CDISC standards and other industry standards that supports the exchange of data, reporting, and analysis.

• Ensures alignment of SDTM standards with data collection standards and relevant company tools/system requirements by reviewing study eCRFs, supporting creation of external data collection standards, and providing SDTM mapping guidance

• Serves as a subject matter expert on all aspects of standards development that includes industry standards (CDISC), regulations, and processes

• Ensures study or portfolio-level SDTM datasets are in compliance with CDISC and regulatory submission requirements, reviews study submission data packages to ensure quality and integrity

• Directly supports knowledge development of others as a subject matter expert on data standards, reporting and analysis standards, change control management and related tools/applications

• Creates quality control processes, metrics and other measures to ensure compliance with standards

• Ensures work carried out in accordance with applicable SOP’s and working practices, as well as global agency regulations/guidance’s

• Creates any needed documentation and training for standard processes, change control management and tools

• Responsible for defining standards specifications working closely with implementation support teams (database set-up, completion guidelines, CRF designers, procedures, algorithm specifications and reporting requirements)

• Facilitates a culture of continuous process improvement and a high level of customer service by maintaining and improving the standards processes associated with standards creation, maintenance, decision-making and implementation

• Working with Digital Solutions and IT, support the implementation of future strategies and technology-enabled processes and tools for clinical trials standards, change control management and the exchange of standards information to internal downstream consumers and externally consumers

• Serves as a liaison between Clinical Programming and External Data Management to ensure data standardization alignment and proactively resolve external data issues that impact SDTM deliverables.

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Life Sciences. Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Life Sciences preferred

• At least 6-8 years relevant experience in a pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO or Regulatory Agency

• Proficient in SAS programming, 6-8 years experience.

• Practical knowledge and experience using R to support clinical trial preferred

• Demonstrated knowledge of clinical research, metadata management, industry standards (CDISC), FDA & ICH, GCP, and related regulatory requirements

• Demonstrated experience managing multiple tasks, complex projects and working with cross functional teams delivering to project and portfolio timelines and metrics

• Strong verbal and written communication skills; independent and effective working in a multi-study, multi-disciplinary atmosphere in a matrix environment

• Experience in clinical data management and/or trial management experience with technical expertise in standards management and implementation is preferred.

Siteimprove helps organisations make their digital content accessible to everyone. Our accessibility products scan entire web estates and document libraries, find the barriers that stop people using them, and increasingly fix those barriers automatically. The work is measured in public: our customers are universities, health systems, government agencies and Fortune 500 companies who have legal deadlines to meet and auditors to satisfy.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead one of our two accessibility product teams. You will own the delivery, quality and technical direction of a cross-functional team of engineers working alongside a Product Manager and a Designer, and you will be accountable for what that team ships and for how the people in it grow.

This role sits at a genuine inflection point. We are moving from finding accessibility problems to explaining and fixing them, and we are rebuilding how we develop software around AI agents that write, test and review code under human direction. We need a leader who is credible in the code, fluent in modern AI-assisted development, and able to coach a team through that change without trading away quality or the well-being of the people doing the work.

What we will be doing

• 
Own delivery for your team. Turn a product roadmap into a sequenced, realistic plan, keep commitments honest, and be the person who says early and clearly when something will not land.

• 
Lead the people. Hold regular one-to-ones, give direct and useful feedback, run performance and growth conversations, and build a team where engineers at different levels can do their best work. Recruit, onboard and retain.

• 
Stay hands-on enough to be credible. Read and review code and designs, take part in architectural decisions, and pair with engineers when it helps. You are not expected to carry a full delivery load, but you are expected to understand the system well enough to challenge a design and to know when an estimate is wrong.

• 
Coach the team in AI-assisted development. Raise the whole team's effectiveness with AI tooling: how to decompose a problem so an agent can take it, how to write a prompt and a specification that produce reviewable work, and how to review agent-generated code properly rather than approving it on sight.

• 
Set the standards for how AI-generated work is accepted. Define with your engineers how such work is reviewed, tested, secured and documented before it merges, and hold the line that a human is always accountable for what ships.

• 
Partner with Product and Design as equals. Work with your Product Manager on outcomes, scope and sequencing, and make the technical trade-offs visible so the three of you decide together.

• 
Work across teams. Depend on and contribute to Platform, AI and other product teams. Much of what your team needs will be built elsewhere, and much of what it builds will be consumed elsewhere.

• 
Protect engineering health. Hold a deliberate balance between roadmap delivery, compliance obligations, customer-reported defects and technical debt, and make that balance explicit rather than letting it be decided by whatever is loudest.

• 
Own quality and operational responsibility. Testing, accessibility conformance of our own products, security and vulnerability remediation, incident response and the reliability of what your team runs in production.

• 
Adjust your working hours to overlap with the United States. This role reports to a manager on the US Pacific coast and partners with colleagues across the US. You will regularly take meetings in the late afternoon or early evening Central European Time, and we will protect the rest of your week in return.

• 
Travel may be required; a valid passport is required

• 
Perform other duties as assigned

What we will require of you

• 
Engineering management experience. Several years leading software engineering teams as their direct manager, including hiring, performance management and developing engineers at more than one level. You have owned delivery for a team over a sustained period, not just a project.

• 
A real software engineering background. You have built and shipped production software yourself and can still read a pull request, follow a design discussion and form your own view. We will talk about systems you have built.

Depth in at least one of our core languages, and comfort across the rest. Our services are written mainly in C# and .NET, TypeScript and JavaScript, Go, Rust and Python. You do not need all of them; you do need to be genuinely strong in one and unafraid of the others.

Modern cloud and delivery practice. AWS, containers and Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, continuous integration and deployment pipelines, observability and on-call practice.

• 
Practical use of AI in the software lifecycle. You have personally used AI coding assistants and agents on real work, you know where they help and where they mislead, and you have opinions about how their output should be reviewed. Experience helping other engineers adopt them is what sets this role apart.

• 
Strong partnership with Product. A track record of working with Product Managers and Designers as a peer, shaping scope rather than receiving it.

• 
Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical audience.

• 
Willingness to work a shifted day. Regular overlap with US Pacific time, and occasional travel.

What we will love about you

Digital accessibility knowledge. Familiarity with WCAG, assistive technology, or the accessibility conformance and reporting that regulated customers require. If you do not have it, you must be willing to learn it properly — it is the product.

Experience in a compliance or regulated environment, such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 or a public-sector authorisation, and comfort working inside an audited change process.

jobs.description:
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) at Aarhus University, Denmark, invites applications for a two-year postdoctoral position in plant regulatory genomics and artificial intelligence, starting 1 April 2027.

You will design new sequence-to-expression deep learning models that predict gene expression from DNA sequence in plants, using new experimental datasets generated in the project. The position includes a 6- to 12-month research stay at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, combining plant genomics expertise at Aarhus with AI expertise at CSHL.

This is an opportunity to advance the state of the art in AI for plant biology while working across two leading research environments. For more information, feel free to reach out to Guillaume Ramstein (QGG) and Peter Koo (CSHL).

Expected start date and duration of employment

This is a 2-year position from April 1st 2027, or as soon as possible.

Job description

You will advance the field of artificial intelligence applied to regulatory genomics, as part of the GRASP project funded by the Independent Research Fund Denmark. In this project, you will leverage new training sets, build novel deep learning architectures and define dedicated learning objectives, to learn the effects of genetic variants on gene expression.

The position will focus on data science and genomics in a model plant species, Brachypodium distachyon. You will work at the cutting edge of AI in biology and propose new solutions to predict the effects of regulatory variants in plant genomes, which remains an open research problem in plant genomics. 

These activities will be carried out in close collaboration with the Koo lab, a leading group in AI and regulatory genomics at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA. As part of this collaboration, the position will include a 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab.

Your profile

Applicants should hold a PhD in computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field, or expect to complete it before the start date. They should have research experience in deep learning.

Applicants are expected to have published in international peer-reviewed journals, preferably on topics related to AI and genomics. Experience in developing new deep learning techniques (model architectures or learning objectives) is especially relevant to this position. 

Good communication skills in English are required, as well as the ability to work in an interdisciplinary team of AI experts, computational geneticists, and plant biologists.

Who we are

The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) is a major center for research and education in quantitative genetics and genomics at Aarhus University (http://www.qgg.au.dk/en). We conduct basic and applied research in animal, plant, and human genetics. Our focus areas include quantitative genetics, artificial intelligence applied to agriculture and medicine, population genetics, and integrative genomics. Research within QGG is characterized by a very close synergy between method development and application on practical problems across species, in collaboration with industry partners. QGG is an international research center with about 70 employees and visiting researchers from over 15 nations. QGG works in teams and strives for an excellent working environment, in which we value self-leadership, open communication, and commitment to diversity and inclusion.

What we offer

The succesful candidate will be offered:

• A 6- to 12-month research stay in the Koo lab at Cold Spring Harbor Laboratory (CSHL), USA, providing international experience and the opportunity to work across two leading labs in plant genomics and AI.
• Computational ressources, including the GenomeDK high-performance computing cluster, with growing capabilities such as high-memory nodes and state-of-the-art GPUs.
• An interdisciplinary interdisciplinary environment, in which the candidate will be able to exchange across research fields (machine learning, bioinformatics, biology, and quantitative genetics) and applications (plant biology, agriculture, and biomedicine).
• A research environment characterized by collaboration, professionalism, commitment to diversity and inclusion, and success in mentoring and supervision.
• A healthy work-life balance.
Place of work and area of employment

The primary place of work is C. F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000, Aarhus (Denmark), and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments.

The position will also include a 6- to 12-month research stay at 1 Bungtown Rd, Cold Spring Harbor, NY 11724, United States. The time and duration of the research stay may be negotiated with the supervisors Guillaume Ramstein and Peter Koo.

Contact information

For further information, please contact:

• Tenure-Track Assistant Professor Guillaume Ramstein, +45 42 52 12 66, ramstein@qgg.au.dk
• Associate Professor Peter Koo, +1 516 367 5520, koo@cshl.edu

You will be responsible for conducting and continuously improving life cycle assessments and product environmental impact assessments, ensuring robust methodologies, transparent assumptions and decision-relevant outputs. Based in the HQ in Denmark you will work across R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, Product and Project Management, Procurement and other functions, you will provide credible evidence to support product development, portfolio decisions, priority Impact4 roadmap initiatives and externally relevant assessments.

You will maintain and contribute to Coloplast’s LCA methodologies, assessment tools, environmental datasets and emission factors. Also support the quality assurance of product-related Scope 3 emission accounting, product KPI progress and other product sustainability metrics. The position offers an opportunity to provide technical expertise and play a key role in advancing Coloplast’s 2030 product sustainability ambitions.

The Sustainability Team

You will join Coloplast’s Global Sustainability team, which sits in Global Quality, Regulatory Affairs and Sustainability under Global Operations. The team leads the development and implementation of the company’s sustainability strategy, including Environment, Health and Safety, and supports the business in delivering on its Impact4 strategic commitments.

We are a team that values curiosity, integrity, collaboration and transparency. We strive to create an environment where people can do their best work while enjoying what they do. Key Responsibilities

•    Apply specialist knowledge in life cycle assessment, product environmental impact assessment, methodologies, datasets, emission factors and product sustainability evidence.

•    Conduct LCAs and product impact assessments across climate and other relevant impact categories, ensuring robust methodologies, transparent assumptions and decision-relevant outputs.

•    Maintain and continuously improve LCA methodologies, assessment tools, datasets, emission factors and technical guidance to ensure consistency, credibility and scalability.

•    Provide environmental impact evidence, methodological guidance and practical tools to support product development, portfolio decisions and sustainability integration across business processes.

•    Support the development and harmonisation of product impact assessment guidance for medical devices, translating evolving scientific, payer, customer and market expectations into practical recommendations.

•    Maintain and contribute to the calculation methodology and quality assurance of environmental impact data used for product-related Scope 3 accounting, product KPI progress and other relevant sustainability metrics.

•    Hands-on experience with leading LCA platforms such as SimaPro, Sphera, OpenLCA, etc. and associated databases.

•    Strong knowledge of relevant standards and methodologies, including ISO 14040/44, ISO 14067, PEF and related environmental assessment frameworks.

•    Strong analytical capabilities and experience working with complex datasets, emission factors, modelling assumptions and decision-support tools.

•    Ability to translate complex environmental assessments into clear, actionable recommendations for product development, portfolio decisions and business stakeholders.

•    Experience from MedTech, healthcare, pharmaceuticals or another regulated industry is an advantage.

If you are motivated by laboratory work, quality assurance, data evaluation, and close collaboration with colleagues across different functions, we offer you an interesting permanent position in a laboratory with a broad range of tasks and stakeholders.

“This is an opportunity to work with quality assurance at different stages of a product’s lifecycle. Join a skilled and collaborative laboratory team

You will become part of an engaged and supportive team with a strong team spirit and a valuable mix of practical laboratory experience and specialist knowledge. In our daily work, we collaborate closely with colleagues across Quality Assurance, Research and Development, and Operations, and we value curiosity, flexibility, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Laboratory work across the product lifecycle

At NBCD, innovation is at our core, enabling us to develop life-changing medications efficiently through pioneering study designs and flawless execution. Our comprehensive support covers everything from study design to regulatory affairs, ensuring expert handling at every step. jobs.occupation: Post Doc in plant-derived extracellular vesicles
jobs.description:
Are you interested in extracellular vesicles from plants and their potential accumulation of unwanted compounds and are you willing to challenge conventional thinking? Then the Department of FOOD Science invites you to apply for a 2-year Post Doc position, funded under the Villum Experiment program.

Expected start date and duration of employment
This is a 2–year position from 1 January 2027, or as soon possible thereafter. 

Job description
The position will focus on the isolation and characterization of extracellular vesicles from plants and understanding their cargo in relation to abiotic conditions.

The Post Doc is expected to independently take part in cultivation of plants, optimizing methods for extraction of extracellular vesicles and development of targeted methods for assessing specific compounds. 

The Post Doc will likewise also be responsible for setting up and running bioactivity assays using mammalian cell-lines.

Your profile
Applicants should hold a PhD in biology, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology or similar.

The preferred candidate has documented hands-on experience with extracellular vesicle isolation and characterization. Likewise hands-on experience with culturing of mammalian cells and various molecular techniques like qPCR, miRNA mapping and LC-MS, is considered positive.

Strong collaborative skills, including experience working in interdisciplinary environments, are essential. We also value creative thinking, personal drive, and excellent communication skills.

Who we are
The Department of Food Science is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University and includes research within the areas Food Chemistry and Technology, Food Quality, Food Metabolomics and proteomics, Sensory Science, Biofunctional Food, Systems Biology, and Plant Production. 

The Department currently employs ca. 145 full-time staff, including 31 senior academic staff, ca. 60 PhD students and Postdocs, and ca. 45 technical and administrative staff. In addition, there are ca. 45 Bachelor and Master thesis students and ca. 10 visiting students and staff, who together contribute to an international research environment where English is the preferred language in the laboratory, at meetings and at seminars.

The Department works in teams and therefore self-leadership, clear and open communication, success in mentoring, supervising and teaching are important qualities needed to be successful in the Department. In addition, the Department has a strong culture that is based on openness, equality, consultation, inclusion and contributing to the Department strategy and working environment are viewed as important.
Aarhus University Food Science: Pioneering Research Partnerships

What we offer 
The candidate will join the multidisciplinary research environment at AU FOOD, with activities spanning the entire food value chain from field to fork. The department provides access to state-of-the-art facilities for plant cultivation under controlled conditions, advanced instrumentation for biomolecular characterization, and two fully equipped cell culture laboratories.

The candidate will join an international and multicultural workplace where English is the primary working language. The department also offers a variety of social activities that contribute to a welcoming and inclusive environment.

Place of work and area of employment 
The place of work is Agro Food Park 48, 8200 Aarhus N, and the area of employment is Aarhus University with related departments. 

Contact information
For further information, please contact: Associated Professor, Martin Krøyer Rasmussen, +452216 9390, martink.rasmussen@food.au.dk.

Deadline
Applications must be received no later than 29 October 2026. 

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the appointment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. All applicants will be notified whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee, and each applicant is given the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that concerns him/her self. 

Formalities and salary range
Technical Sciences refers to the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Danish Universities under the Danish Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation.

The application must be in English and include a curriculum vitae, degree certificate, a complete list of publications, a statement of future research plans and information about research activities, teaching portfolio and verified information on previous teaching experience (if any). Guidelines for applicants can be found here.

Appointment shall be in accordance with the collective labour agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Further information on qualification requirements and job content may be found in the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Danish Universities.

Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions at basic salary steps 4-8.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

Research activities will be evaluated in relation to actual research time. Thus, we encourage applicants to specify periods of leave without research activities, in order to be able to subtract these periods from the span of the scientific career during the evaluation of scientific productivity.

Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including relocation service and career counselling to expat partners. Read more here. Please find more information about entering and working in Denmark here.

Aarhus University also offers a Junior Researcher Development Programme targeted at career development for postdocs at AU. You can read more about it here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.
